subject: general
question: With which of the following organisations was Lala Har Dayal associated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ghadar Party**__.

__
 
• One of the co-founders of the Ghadar Party is Har Dayal.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The Ghadar Party was formed by a group of Indian revolutionaries that included migrant workers from Punjab and Bengali and Punjabi intellectuals and students.

 
 
• Its main objective is to reflect the values ​​of independent India by overthrowing the British rule and adopting secularism and unity despite regional, religious and linguistic differences.
 
• It was established in the year 1913.
 
• The party was dissolved in 1948 after India gained independence.
 
• Its founders were Hardayal, Sohan Singh Bhakna, Santokh Singh, Baba Jwala Singh, Vashakha Singh Dandekar.
 
• The party launched its first newspaper 'Gadar' (Weekly) in November 1913.
 
• The title of the newspaper is 'Angrezi Raj Ka Dushman' (Enemy of British Raj).
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 Lala Lajpatrai
 
 
 
• He was an Independence Indian activist.
 
• He is known as Punjab Kesari(Lion of Punjab).
 
 
 
 

 Gopal Krishan Gokhale
 
 
 
• Gopal Krishan Gokhale was a social reformer and political leader during the Indian Independence movement.
 
• He was the founder of Servants of Indian Society.
 
 
 
 

 Dada Bhai Naroji
 
 
 
• Dada Bhai Naroji was an Indian social-political leader.
 
• He is known as the 'Grand old man of India' and 'Unofficial Ambassador of India'.
